_comment: Turns are anchored to their opening words ('at'), so this works with the caption transcript now and the whisper transcript later. Speaker split is by meaning (burialgoods voices all three) — re-check against the audio.

cast.brisket: Brother Brisket - black, scarred bull; troubled, then vengeful
cast.chuck: Brother Chuck - fat brown bull; content, knows more than he says; joins at the end
cast.dennis: Dennis - Brisket's son, returned from the shed in a vet cone; says odd things from the barn

turns.at: Brother, we rule over this prairie
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: Of course, brother. They are in the herd
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: Do you see any of them
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: Why yes, I see your son
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: Yes, and there is something wrong
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: Lovely weather here in the barn
turns.speaker: dennis

turns.at: The tall, skinny ones. They've done
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: No, now you sound like the pigs
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: So, you have heard them speaking
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: I do not think that is how they see it
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: Then they must surely fear us
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: And gore them with our horns
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: You speak of the pigs again
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: They call it the shed of no return
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: Yes, they took Dennis to that shed
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: And we can make as many more
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: There is nothing else to see
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: You know more than you are saying
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: And if you do not wish to have more sadness
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: Dennis won't be able to sire
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: Of course not, brother. He would challenge
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: some for meat and some for milk
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: I could break the great fence
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: I could charge through the door
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: There are more of the tall, skinny ones
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: I could. If you helped me
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: And what then? If you did
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: Well, indeed, brother, then we will leave
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: Not if we kill them, too
turns.speaker: brisket

turns.at: Can you kill all of them
turns.speaker: chuck

turns.at: No, but I can kill more
turns.speaker: brisket
